The target uses rounded face/hand volumes, a constructed polo collar/placket/sleeves/hem and distinct dark shoes. rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: Rosa has a continuous, appealing chocolate-brown bob: a fuller flowing crown/sweep, rounded readable fringe and side/nape volumes that work in all four views. Replace the source cap-like flat crown, abrupt lumpy joins and visible skin wedges between hair pieces with deliberate construction. Face, torso, arms, hands, trousers and shoes gain useful volume/proportion refinement within actual rig/contact and functional envelope.

Warm tan face retains Rosa’s friendly small dark eyes/glints, nose, cheeks and smile with clearer softly rounded forms. Coral shirt reads as a constructed polo with a readable collar/opening, sleeve finish and hem; navy trousers and dark shoes remain separately readable. Purposeful broad details carry the target’s crafted feel without noisy microdetail.

Keep tan skin, chocolate-brown bob, coral red shirt, navy lower garment and dark shoes, with broad gentle highlights and readable warm midtones. The head and shirt should no longer read as large flat dark caps/red slabs; lower tones retain useful form separation rather than nearly black blocks.

Walk, sit/stand, eat, gestures and waiting preserve their functional meaning and cadence. Hands, feet, seat and mouth relationships remain stable; meal sprites read as carried/consumed food with correct natural occlusion rather than pasted-over body parts. Food-free states remain empty.
